timingDefinition.metric: fashion.set wall time minus disjoint harness-added getError/isBuffer call intervals
timingDefinition.note: Bounded exact-Worker control measured 5.6–8.6ms when both added query kinds were disabled only inside set. The full matrix retains every query and records raw, probe and exclusive times; it does not claim a raw300 or physical-device result.

limits: Exact local production Worker and dist/client; isolated synthetic D1 and synthetic request headers, no real users or hosted authentication.
Synthetic rAF/performance clock, actual selected native WebGL draws; intermediate frames update motion/effects without GPU draws.
Chromium SwiftShader; no physical device/GPU or full cloth/flame collision simulation.
Fashion is a private candidate and has not been deployed.
